Bombay High Court Rules Duty-Free Shops Subject to Indian Laws

The Bombay High Court has rejected a plea by Gautam Adani's entity that duty-free shops located in international departure areas are beyond the reach of domestic laws. The court ruled that these shops must comply with Indian regulations, specifically in relation to the sale of nicotine pouches. This decision is seen as setting a precedent for India's duty-free sector.
